name: Yev — a stone in the stream

start.speaker: yev
start.text: Sit. The Weft is loud tonight and you are the quietest thing in it. When I reach for the current I find you at the edge, every time, like a stone in a stream. I have started to reach for the stone.

choices.text: Yev, I am your friend. The stream is enough for me.

reach.speaker: yev
reach.text: Then I will. Slowly. The grove taught me slowly.

stream.speaker: yev
stream.text: The stream is a good thing to be. So be it, friend.
